2608.24570.title: EviDx: Evidence-Aware Active Diagnosis with Scaffolded LLM Agents
2608.24570.paper_summary: Clinical diagnosis is an active evidence-seeking process in which clinicians acquire evidence, update competing hypotheses, and decide when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. Yet many medical diagnosis systems built around large language models (LLMs) still formulate diagnosis as static case-to-answer prediction, with limited support for evidence acquisition. Agentic LLMs offer a dynamic alternative through tool use and intermediate diagnostic trajectories, but existing systems often under-specify how patient evidence should be exposed, scaffolded, and controlled at runtime. We introduce EviDx, an evidence-aware active diagnosis framework that pairs patient-specific diagnostic environments with a clinical diagnostic scaffold and an observer-guided runtime harness. In EviDx, $\mathcal{E}$-Synthesis constructs interactive environments from raw clinical cases; the scaffold organizes role-specialized agents, evidence tools, and evolving evidence states; and the harness regulates diagnostic termination by tracking uncertainty and evidence coverage. A 3-level evaluation pyramid assesses execution robustness, reasoning dynamics, and diagnostic outcomes. Experiments show that EviDx improves diagnostic performance and process stability while revealing model-dependent capability boundaries.
2608.24570.paper_summary_zh: 臨床診斷是一個主動尋求證據的過程，在這個過程中，臨床醫生獲取證據、更新競爭假設，並決定何時可用的證據足以進行診斷。<lb/>然而，許多基於大型語言模型（LLMs）的醫療診斷系統仍然將診斷表述為靜態的案例到答案的預測，對於證據獲取的支持有限。<lb/>代理型LLMs通過工具使用和中間診斷軌跡提供了一種動態的替代方案，但現有系統通常未明確說明患者證據應如何在運行時被揭示、搭建和控制。<lb/>我們介紹了EviDx，一個以證據為中心的主動診斷框架，將特定於患者的診斷環境與臨床診斷框架和觀察者引導的運行時工具結合在一起。<lb/>在EviDx中，$\mathcal{E}$-Synthesis從原始臨床案例構建互動環境；框架組織角色專門化的代理、證據工具和不斷演變的證據狀態；而工具則通過跟蹤不確定性和證據覆蓋來調節診斷終止。<lb/>一個三層評估金字塔評估執行穩健性、推理動態和診斷結果。<lb/>實驗顯示，EviDx改善了診斷性能和過程穩定性，同時揭示了模型依賴的能力邊界。
